story.iWant: I want to list, filter, create, edit, or deactivate users and assign roles
story.soThat: so that I can manage security and onboard/change staff

tasks.task: User listing and filtering: Create UserController endpoint GET /api/v1/users with query parameters (role, status, search, page, size), implement UserService.findAllWithFilters with company scoping, add UserRepository query methods (findByRoleAndCompanyId, findByEmailContainingIgnoreCase, findByFullNameContainingIgnoreCase), return paginated response with UserDTO list (exclude password_hash), add RBAC (only admin/chief_accountant can list users)

User creation and validation: Create POST /api/v1/users endpoint (admin/chief only), create CreateUserRequest DTO with validation (email unique/format, fullName, role optional/default accountant, companyId auto from context), implement UserService.createUser with email uniqueness check per company, generate temporary password or send invitation email (reuse InvitationService from Story 1.4), validate all fields using Bean Validation, return 400 Bad Request with field errors if validation fails, return 409 Conflict if email already exists, audit log user creation (AUDIT_USER_CREATED)

User update and validation: Create PUT /api/v1/users/{id} endpoint (admin/chief only, or user editing own profile), create UpdateUserRequest DTO with optional fields (fullName, role if admin/chief, status), implement UserService.updateUser with validation (email cannot be changed, role changes follow Story 1.4 rules, status changes only admin/chief, user can edit own fullName but not role or status), audit log user updates (AUDIT_USER_UPDATED) with old/new values

User deactivation and login prevention: Add status field to User entity if not present (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED), update AuthService.login() to check user status and reject if INACTIVE with message "Account is deactivated", create PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/deactivate endpoint (admin/chief only), create PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/activate endpoint (admin/chief only), deactivated users appear in separate section or with visual indicator in listing, audit log activation/deactivation (AUDIT_USER_DEACTIVATED, AUDIT_USER_ACTIVATED)

Password reset by admin: Create POST /api/v1/users/{id}/reset-password endpoint (admin/chief only), generate secure password reset token (reuse EmailService.sendPasswordResetEmail from Story 1.3), token expires after 30 minutes, send password reset email to user (reuse EmailService pattern), audit log password reset initiated by admin (AUDIT_PASSWORD_RESET_ADMIN) with admin user_id and target user_id

User profile management: Create GET /api/v1/users/me endpoint (authenticated users only), return current user profile (email, fullName, role, companyId, createdAt), create PUT /api/v1/users/me endpoint for profile updates, allow updating fullName only (reject role/status changes), create POST /api/v1/users/me/change-password endpoint, validate current password, new password strength, confirm password match, update password_hash using BCrypt, audit log profile changes (AUDIT_PROFILE_UPDATED) and password changes (AUDIT_PASSWORD_CHANGED)

Role badge data in responses: Ensure UserDTO includes role field (already in User entity from Story 1.4), return role in all user listing and detail endpoints, role display formatting follows Story 1.4 patterns (lowercase in DB, uppercase in responses)

User listing page: Create UserManagement page (extend existing from Story 1.4 or create new if needed), display user table with columns (Email, Full Name, Role Badge, Status, Actions), add filters (Role dropdown: all, admin, accountant, chief_accountant, cfo; Status dropdown: all, active, inactive), add search input (typeahead on email and name), add pagination controls (20 per page), visual separation for inactive users (grayed out or separate section), role badge component (reuse from Story 1.4)

User creation form: Create CreateUserDialog/Modal component, form fields (Email required/validated, Full Name required, Role optional/default accountant), email uniqueness check (show error if duplicate), form validation (email format, required fields), submit creates user via POST /api/v1/users, show success message with user details

User edit form: Create EditUserDialog component, load user data from GET /api/v1/users/{id}, form fields (Full Name editable, Role editable if admin/chief/disabled if own account, Status toggle admin/chief only), validation (cannot change own role - show warning if attempt), submit updates user via PUT /api/v1/users/{id}

User deactivation UI: Add "Deactivate" button in user row (admin/chief only, disabled for own account), confirmation modal ("Are you sure you want to deactivate {email}? They will not be able to log in."), call PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/deactivate, update UI (show inactive badge, gray out row), add "Activate" button for inactive users

Password reset by admin: Add "Reset Password" button in user row (admin/chief only), confirmation modal ("Send password reset email to {email}?"), call POST /api/v1/users/{id}/reset-password, show success message ("Password reset email sent")

User profile page: Create UserProfile page at route /profile, display current user info (Email read-only, Full Name editable, Role read-only badge, Company read-only), edit profile form (update fullName via PUT /api/v1/users/me), change password form (current password field, new password field with strength indicator, confirm password field, validation: current password must match, new password strength, passwords must match, submit via POST /api/v1/users/me/change-password), show success/error messages for profile and password updates

Backend: Unit tests for UserService (create, update, deactivate, activation), integration tests for user listing with filters (role, status, search), integration tests for user creation (success, duplicate email, validation failures), integration tests for user update (success, validation, role change restrictions, self-edit restrictions), integration tests for deactivation (login blocked, visual separation), integration tests for password reset by admin (email sent, token expiry), integration tests for profile management (GET /me, PUT /me, change password), integration tests for audit logging (all user operations logged)

Frontend: Unit tests for UserManagement page (filters, search, table display), unit tests for CreateUserDialog (form validation, submission), unit tests for EditUserDialog (form validation, role restrictions), unit tests for UserProfile page (profile edit, password change), integration tests (test full user management flow: create, edit, deactivate, activate, reset password; test profile self-edit flow: update name, change password), E2E tests (test user management permissions: admin can manage, accountant cannot)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: User listing supports filtering by role, status, and search by email/name
Create/edit user form validates all fields; cannot duplicate email
Deactivated users cannot log in (and are visually separated)
"Reset password" flow allows admin to send an email to users; link expires after 30 minutes
Profile screen allows user to edit their own name, view effective role, change password
Role badge displayed on each user in lists and details
User creation, edit, activation, deactivation, and role changes are all audit-logged with who/when

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: The system must define four roles with clear permissions: Admin (Technical) manages users, system configurations, and company settings; Accountant creates documents, views reports, manages master data; Chief Accountant closes accounting periods, approves documents, full accounting access, views audit logs; CFO has view-only access to financial reports and data.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: The system must record an append-only log for critical actions: document creation (who/when), posting (who/when). Logs cannot be deleted or modified.

constraints.constraint: User entity already exists from Story 1.2 and Story 1.3, with role field from Story 1.4. Status field may need to be added if not present (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED). Migration V7 needed if field doesn't exist.
RBAC enforcement: Follow Story 1.4 patterns - only admin and chief_accountant can manage users (create, edit, deactivate, reset password). Regular users can only edit their own profile.
Email uniqueness: Must be unique per company (multi-tenancy). Validate at database level (unique constraint on email + company_id) and application level.
Password reset: Reuse EmailService.sendPasswordResetEmail from Story 1.3. Token generation and expiration logic already implemented. Token expires after 30 minutes.
Audit logging: Use AuditService from Story 1.4. Log all user operations: CREATE, UPDATE, DEACTIVATE, ACTIVATE, PASSWORD_RESET_ADMIN, PROFILE_UPDATED, PASSWORD_CHANGED.
Company scoping: All user operations must be company-scoped. Users can only see/manage users in their company via CompanyScopedEntity interface.

Invitation integration: User creation can optionally use InvitationService from Story 1.4 instead of direct creation (sends invitation email). For MVP, support both direct creation (with temporary password) and invitation flow.
Role change restrictions: Users cannot change own role, only admin/chief can change roles. Follow Story 1.4 rules for role change validation.
Status field: If User entity doesn't have status field, add it: status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' with values: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED. Migration needed: V7__add_user_status_field.sql.
Profile self-edit: Users can edit own fullName but not role or status. Profile endpoints (/me) should reject role/status changes.
Password validation: Reuse password strength validation from Story 1.3. BCrypt used for password hashing.
Frontend patterns: UserManagement page structure exists from Story 1.4 - extend with filters, search, deactivation UI. Role badge component pattern from Story 1.4 - reuse for role display.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/users
interface.description: List users with filtering by role, status, and search by email/name. Returns paginated UserDTO list. Requires ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT role.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/users
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/users - Body: CreateUserRequest { email, fullName, role? }
interface.description: Create new user with role assignment. Validates email uniqueness per company. Returns created UserDTO. Requires ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT role.

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/users/{id}
interface.signature: PUT /api/v1/users/{id} - Body: UpdateUserRequest { fullName?, role?, status? }
interface.description: Update user (fullName, role if admin/chief, status if admin/chief). Email cannot be changed. User can edit own fullName but not role or status. Requires ADMIN/CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT role or user editing own profile.

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/deactivate
interface.description: Deactivate user - sets status to INACTIVE. Deactivated users cannot log in. Requires ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT role.

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/activate
interface.description: Activate user - sets status to ACTIVE. Requires ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT role.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/users/{id}/reset-password
interface.description: Initiate password reset by admin - generates reset token, sends email to user. Token expires after 30 minutes. Requires ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT role.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/users/me
interface.description: Get current user profile (email, fullName, role, companyId, createdAt). Requires authenticated user.

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/users/me
interface.description: Update current user profile - only fullName can be updated. Rejects role/status changes. Requires authenticated user.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/users/me/change-password
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/users/me/change-password - Body: ChangePasswordRequest { currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword }
interface.description: Change current user password - validates current password, new password strength, confirm password match. Updates password_hash using BCrypt. Requires authenticated user.

interface.name: UserService.findAllWithFilters
interface.signature: List<User> findAllWithFilters(String role, String status, String search, Pageable pageable)
interface.description: Find users with filtering by role, status, and search. Company-scoped via CompanyScopedEntity. Returns paginated list.

interface.name: EmailService.sendPasswordResetEmail
interface.description: Send password reset email to user with reset token. Reuse for admin-initiated password reset (AC#4).

interface.name: AuditService.logUserCreated
interface.signature: void logUserCreated(User user, Long createdByUserId, HttpServletRequest request)
interface.description: Log user creation operation. Records user details, creator, timestamp, IP address. Required for AC#7.

interface.name: AuthService.login
interface.signature: AuthResponse login(String email, String password, HttpServletRequest request)
interface.description: Authenticate user - must check user status and reject if INACTIVE with message "Account is deactivated". Required for AC#3.

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test with Testcontainers for integration tests. Mockito for service unit tests (user validation, permission checks). Test coverage: user operations (create, update, deactivate, activate, reset password, profile management), RBAC enforcement, audit logging verification. Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library for UserManagement and UserProfile components. Test coverage: form validation, submission, role restrictions, permission checks. Integration: Test user management flow end-to-end (create, edit, deactivate, activate, reset password, profile self-edit). Security: Test RBAC enforcement (non-admin cannot manage users, users cannot change own role). Audit: Verify all user operations are logged with correct fields.
tests.locations: Backend tests: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/service/impl/UserServiceImplTest.java (unit tests), backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/controller/admin/UserControllerIntegrationTest.java (integration tests). Frontend tests: frontend/src/**/*.test.tsx (component unit tests), frontend/src/**/*.spec.ts (integration tests). Test utilities: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/test/IntegrationTest.java (base integration test class with Testcontainers setup).

ideas.test: Test user listing with various filter combinations (role only, status only, search only, combined filters). Verify pagination works correctly. Test company scoping - users can only see users in their company.

Test user creation with valid data, duplicate email (should return 409), invalid email format (should return 400), missing required fields (should return 400). Test user update with valid data, attempt to change email (should be rejected), role change restrictions (non-admin cannot change roles, users cannot change own role).

Test deactivated user cannot log in (should return 401 with message "Account is deactivated"). Test deactivated users appear in separate section or with visual indicator in listing. Test activation flow - deactivated user can be activated and then can log in.
Test password reset by admin - verify reset token is generated, email is sent, token expires after 30 minutes. Test expired token cannot be used. Test password reset flow completion using the token.

Test profile endpoints (/me) - verify current user can view own profile, update fullName, cannot update role/status. Test password change - verify current password validation, new password strength validation, confirm password match validation, successful password update.
Test role badge display in user listing and detail views. Verify role formatting (lowercase in DB, uppercase in responses).

Test audit logging for all user operations - verify logUserCreated, logUserUpdated, logUserDeactivated, logUserActivated, logPasswordResetByAdmin, logProfileUpdated, logPasswordChanged are called with correct parameters. Verify audit log entries contain who/when information.

Test RBAC enforcement - non-admin/chief cannot access user management endpoints (should return 403). Users cannot change own role (should return 403 or 400). Admin/chief can manage all users except cannot change own role.
Test company scoping - users can only see/manage users in their company. Cross-company access attempts should be rejected or return empty results.
